_doc: Narration for EditorBro: One Prompt, Every Creator. HYPE delivery from 0.1 s (user, 2026-10-31): short shouted lines, low stability + high style. 'cap' = Roman caption, 'tts' = what Liam reads (use '.' '!' '?' ',' as phrase marks; they must match cap). Cuts are re-snapped to the song's measured beat grid after the take.
